title: Shared derived localization and elementary normalizations of supported signed-twist classes
statement: Fix the finite coefficient datum $P$ and, for either the small etale or small pro-etale site, the module-sheaf category, supported Hom groups $H_i^a(X,A(r))$, degree-zero embedding and constant sheaf of [def-pur-supported-class-operations]. Use the existing small derived localization of this same sheaf category, with Hom universe $u+1$ for schemes in universe $u$. For every closed immersion $i:C\hookrightarrow X$, integers $a,b,r,s$, equalities $h_a:a=b$, $h_r:r=s$, and $\alpha\in H_i^a(X,A(r))$, define its equality reindexing in $H_i^b(X,A(s))$ by substitution along $h_a$ and $h_r$. For the identity closed immersion $\mathrm{id}_X$, define the full-support coefficient-source isomorphism $(\mathrm{id}_X)_*A_X\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X$ to be the canonical direct-image identity unitor, on each of the two sites. These are the existing constructions only; no functoriality or cup-product laws are asserted.
